description: Crossfades two signals across two outputs, or pans one signal between them

params.text: Sets the balance between the two inputs: at the far left IN 1 goes to OUT 1 and IN 2 to OUT 2, at the far right they are swapped, and in between the outputs carry a blend of both
Scales the X FADE input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed

inputs.text: Moves the balance by an amount set by the X FADE attenuverter
One of the two signals being crossfaded
One of the two signals being crossfaded

outputs.text: IN 1 fading out as the balance moves right, mixed with IN 2 fading in
IN 1 fading in as the balance moves right, mixed with IN 2 fading out

menu: Pan law — chooses -6 dB (linear), a straight-line fade suited to control voltage, or -3 dB, which lifts the middle of the fade by 3dB and pans stereo audio more evenly
